ruleBlocks.text: В придаточных времени и условия (if, when, while, as soon as, before, after, by the time, in case, till/until, unless) в future-контексте обычно ставим Present Simple, а не will.

ruleBlocks.caption: Decision pattern
rows: I'll call you when I arrive

ruleBlocks.caption: Союзы, которые чаще запускают правило no will
rows: If you leave your car here, you will get a fine.
when, while, as soon as, before, after, by the time
When you see Nelly, ask her to call me.
We'll keep the boxes until we move.

ruleBlocks.title: High-frequency traps
lines: when I will finish -> when I finish
if she will call -> if she calls
as soon as you will see -> as soon as you see
until we will move -> until we move

items.en: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you leave.
items.ru: Не забудь выключить свет перед тем, как уйдешь.

items.en: If you arrive late, the best things will have gone.
items.ru: Если придешь поздно, лучшие вещи уже разберут.

items.en: As soon as you see Mrs. Minks, ask her to call me.
items.ru: Как только увидишь миссис Минкс, попроси ее мне позвонить.

items.en: We'll keep these boxes until we move to a bigger place.
items.ru: Мы сохраним эти коробки, пока не переедем в место побольше.

items.prompt: I'll call you when I arrive.
items.explain: В future-контексте после when ставим Present Simple.

items.prompt: If she is late, we'll start without her.
items.explain: Реальное условие будущего: if + Present Simple.

items.prompt: We'll leave as soon as the rain stops.
items.explain: as soon as работает как союз времени, поэтому форма Present Simple.

items.prompt: I won't go unless he apologizes.
items.explain: unless = if ... not; здесь нужен Present Simple.

items.prompt: Don't forget to lock the door before you leave.
items.explain: После before в таком контексте ставим Present Simple.

items.prompt: The mats can stay here until we move to a bigger house.
items.explain: После until в future-контексте обычно Present Simple.

items.prompt: I'll text you when I ____ (arrive).
items.explain: После when -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: If it ____ (rain), we'll stay home.
items.explain: If-clause: Present Simple.

items.prompt: We'll leave as soon as he ____ (finish).
items.explain: После as soon as ставим Present Simple.

items.prompt: I'll call you when I will know the result.
accepted: I'll call you when I know the result.
I will call you when I know the result.
items.explain: В when-clause убираем will.

items.prompt: Unless she ____ (apologize), we won't continue.
items.explain: unless + Present Simple.

items.prompt: We'll buy tickets before prices ____ (go) up.
items.explain: В before-clause здесь нужна базовая форма Present Simple.

items.prompt: As soon as you ____ (see) Mrs. Minks, ask her to ring me up.
items.explain: После as soon as не используем will.

items.prompt: The other mats can be stowed away until we ____ (move) to a bigger house.
items.explain: until + Present Simple в будущем контексте.

items.prompt: Какие союзы чаще запускают правило no will in clause?
items.explain: Все эти союзы типично требуют Present Simple в future-контексте.

items.prompt: Какие варианты естественны в придаточной части?
options: as soon as you see him
items.explain: Вариант с will в придаточной - типичная ошибка.

items.prompt: When I will get home, I'll call you.
accepted: When I get home, I'll call you.
When I get home, I will call you.
items.explain: После when -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: If she will be late, we will start.
accepted: If she is late, we will start.
If she is late, we'll start.
items.explain: После if в таком условии не ставим will.

items.prompt: As soon as you will see Mr. Black, ask him about the report.
accepted: As soon as you see Mr. Black, ask him about the report.
items.explain: После as soon as нужна форма Present Simple.

items.prompt: We won't start until everyone will arrive.
accepted: We won't start until everyone arrives.
We will not start until everyone arrives.
items.explain: После until в future-контексте ставим Present Simple.

items.prompt: Don't forget to turn off the lights before you ____ .
items.explain: before-clause с future meaning -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: As soon as she ____ back, give her the letters.
items.explain: После as soon as в будущем контексте -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: If you ____ late, the best things will have gone.
items.explain: If-clause здесь требует Present Simple.

items.prompt: We'll keep the old furniture until we ____ to a bigger flat.
items.explain: until + Present Simple в future-контексте.

items.prompt: PHOTO: departure board and suitcase. We ____ (text) you when we ____ (get) to the station.
items.explain: Главная часть -> will; after when -> Present Simple.

items.prompt: PHOTO: office team near whiteboard. If she ____ (be) late, we ____ (start) without her.
items.explain: if-clause -> Present Simple; main clause -> will.
